# CloudGate Storage

> Cloud storage app for Android, iPhone and the web. 100GB free cloud storage
> for photos, videos and documents, with 250GB, 500GB and 1TB plans available.
> Storage allowances are defined limits; there is no unlimited plan.

CloudGate Storage is published by CloudGate Technologies Pty Limited (ACN 673 209 553),
based in Canning Vale, Western Australia.

## Plans
- Free: 100GB, no card required, not a trial
- Plus: 250GB
- Pro: 500GB
- Family: 1TB
Monthly and yearly billing are both available.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://cloudgate-app.com): what the app does and who it is for
- [Features and plans](https://cloudgate-app.com/features): capabilities and the four storage tiers
- [Cloud Tips](https://cloudgate-app.com/cloud-tips): index of setup and how-to guides

## Guides
- [How to back up your phone to free cloud storage](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/backup-setup): full walkthrough for Android, iPhone and web
- [Cloud storage for Android](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/cloud-storage-android): permissions, folder selection, battery optimisation, Samsung Device Care
- [Free cloud storage for iPhone](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/cloud-storage-iphone): All Photos vs Limited Access, background refresh, Low Power Mode
- [What 100GB free cloud storage gets you](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/free-cloud-storage-100gb): capacity in photos, video and documents
- [Cloud storage for videos and large video files](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/cloud-storage-for-videos): real 1080p and 4K file sizes, where to store large videos, backing up without using mobile data
- [Cross platform cloud storage across your devices](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/cross-platform-cloud-storage): one account on Android, iPhone and the web, and switching phone platforms
- [How to backup photos](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/how-to-backup-photos): where to store photos online, originals versus compressed copies, photos other people sent you
- [Phone storage full? How to free up space safely](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/phone-storage-full): back up, verify, then delete; finding what is using the space
- [Move everything to a new phone in one sitting](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/switch-to-new-phone): order of operations and what to check before a factory reset
- [Web cloud storage](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/web-cloud-storage): uploading and opening files in a browser with nothing to install
- [Why your backup is quietly skipping files](https://cloudgate-app.com/guides/why-backups-skip-files): the real reasons backups miss files and how to check each one
